summary: Fixed REV-1 (R9): a newly created app no longer opens with the previous app's git drawer or expanded git tools. openApp now takes an optional app list so callers can supply the just-saved list, and handleSave routes the new-app app-view transition through openApp(saved.id, next) instead of calling setView("app") directly. That reuses the same calm reset (gitTab/gitTabKept cleared, gitToolsOpen false, first terminal selected). The pre-commit selectApp was removed because the reset now covers it. Added an R9 regression test that opens the git drawer on one app, creates and saves a new app, and asserts the new app opens with no drawer or console, collapsed git tools and its own first terminal visible. All previously reported tests still pass; typecheck, the full 428-test suite and the production build pass, with the palette still in its own on-demand chunk.
